findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns the unmodified config, discarding schedule_type display value
findings.body: The function creates `config = monitor_environment.monitor.config.copy()` and conditionally replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with `get_schedule_type_display()`, but the returned dict uses `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. The copy and mutation are therefore dead, and issue occurrence contexts will contain the raw `schedule_type` choice/enum value rather than the human-readable display value. This defeats the only reason for making the copy and gives consumers incorrect monitor config data.

findings.title: Moved module-level symbols removed from mark_failed without re-export
findings.body: This refactor removes `SimpleCheckIn`, `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and moves them to other modules without leaving backwards-compatible re-exports in `mark_failed.py`. Any existing code or tests that import these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will now fail with ImportError. All importers should be updated, or the old module should re-export the moved names.
